narrationTexts: Fix confirmed. Two real bugs, not just deprecation noise.
finalText:
**Build is clean.** Exit 0, `0 errors`.

Two real bugs from the bump, both now fixed:

1. [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) — bundler now sends `retryCount`, code still read `options.retries` (`undefined`), threw on `.toFixed(0)`.
2. [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so the strict check threw instead of treating it as disabled.

The remaining 8 `WARN DEP...` lines are genuine deprecation noise from the bumped packages, not build-breaking. Worth scheduling a cleanup pass later, but nothing to do now.
